question: (1)/(20) { is what percentage of } (11)/(80)? ({Round off the answer to two decimal places.})
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find what percentage one fraction is of another:

Percentage = (Fraction 1 ÷ Fraction 2) × 100

⇒ Percentage = (1 ÷ 20) ÷ (11 ÷ 80) × 100

⇒ Percentage = (1 × 80) ÷ (20 × 11) × 100 = 80 ÷ 220 × 100 = 36.36%

**∴ Answer = 36.36%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Fraction 1 = 1 ÷ 20

Fraction 2 = 11 ÷ 80

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (Fraction 1 ÷ Fraction 2) × 100

 1 ÷ 20 11 ÷ 80 
• Division 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (1 ÷ 20) ÷ (11 ÷ 80) = (1 × 80) ÷ (20 × 11)

⇒ 80 ÷ 220 × 100 = 36.36%

**∴ The correct answer is 36.36%.**
